name: Special Meeting of the Public Safety Commission
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA - (562) 865-6262

  TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2019

  5:00 P.M.

  VICE CHAIRPERSON BETTY LOU ORMONDE
  COMMISSIONER MELINDA VEGA
  COMMISSIONER DEAN SORGDRAGER
  COMMISSIONER MICHAEL EUGENIO
  COMMISSIONER LOU TREROTOLA

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

ELECTION OF NEW CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

COMMUNICATION FROM THE AUDIENCE

This is the time for public input relative to issues on or not on the printed agenda.
Please observe the time of three (3) minutes. Speaker Cards are available at the door
and may be delivered to the recording secretary prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Comments on the listed agenda items will only be taken when the
Commission reaches that item on the agenda.

OLD BUSINESS

  1. Adopt the Minutes From the Following Meeting: July 30, 2019

NEW BUSINESS

  2. Outreach Opportunities for the Public Safety Commission at Events
 COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

 Adjournment to the next Regular Public Safety Commission Meeting to be held
  on Tuesday, October 1, 2019, at 6:00 p.m., in the Albert O. Little Community
  Center at 18750 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
